text: Lawrence: Trump failed to explain his war, disgraced military calling it 'a little journey to Iran'MS NOW’s Lawrence O’Donnell describes how Donald Trump “failed at explaining his war as badly as he has failed at waging his war” while he also “insulted the commitment of every member of the military involved in Donald Trump's war by calling his war, ‘that little journey to Iran.’” MS NOW: My Source for News, Opinion, and the World. » Subscribe to MS NOW: https://www.youtube.com/@msnow MS NOW is the go-to destination for domestic and international breaking news, and best-in-class opinion journalism.
